title: The missing DNA strand
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: A pairs with T, and G pairs with C. The complementary strand runs antiparallel, so 5′–A T G C–3′ pairs with 3′–T A C G–5′.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: A pairs with T, and G pairs with C. The complementary strand runs antiparallel, so 5′–A T G C–3′ pairs with 3′–T A C G–5′.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: A DNA strand reads 5′–A T G C–3′. What is its complementary strand written in the opposite direction, 3′ to 5′? A pairs with T, and G pairs with C. The complementary strand runs antiparallel, so 5′–A T G C–3′ pairs with 3′–T A C G–5′.
Recall: Which DNA base pairs with G? In ordinary DNA base pairing, guanine pairs with cytosine.
The figure is a simplified model and is not to scale.
